h: Wike reportedly denies endorsing Labour Party's Abbo in Adamawa governorship race
p: Claims that FCT Minister Nyesom Wike backed the Labour Party's candidate for the Adamawa governorship have drawn attention online. Wike is said to have denied the report. Observers are watching how the race develops ahead of 2027.
more: Wike has reportedly rejected the endorsement claim.
The Adamawa governorship race is attracting wider attention.
